error-panel.name: Error Panel
error-panel.purpose: Present one blocking or recoverable error surface with action and context without owning incident, retry, or support flows.

anatomy.rule: Owns the visible Error Panel container.
Uses symbol, icon, or motion support.

error-panel.statePrecedence: disabled > critical > error > warning > loading > default

Energy.decision: Use Energy so Error Panel remains a bounded component.
Energy.behavior: Error Panel exposes local state without absorbing patterns.
Energy.rejectIf: Incident recovery, support handoff, and multi-step remediation belong to patterns.

do: Use Error Panel for its bounded job.
dont: Incident recovery, support handoff, and multi-step remediation belong to patterns.
Do not create multi-step system inside it.
Do not rely on color or motion only.
info: Escalate to patterns when orchestration appears.
